checks: All three headless restored tasks pass initial/final expected pixels.
Weighted synthetic 3-node cycle and independent self-loop verify graph sizes, sample counts, memory/length histograms and self-loop percentages.
Numeric edge artifacts pass byte-for-byte zstd round trips. Guest code prefixes are omitted from committed data.
limits: Transitions are native-return IPs before possible interpreter replay, not complete consecutive dispatch traces. Rare replay edges and interpreted gaps require care in a chaining design.
Address graph aggregates physical code generations; raw numeric records keep page/generation identity.
Code prefixes were captured after calls for private inspection and are not committed.
Two Excel runs use the same deterministic jitter seed; no formal independent-sampling confidence claim.
Word is one shorter diagnostic run. Instrumented timings must not be compared with normal executable timings.
